title: 第21章 明兰师姐 我下线了第22章 五品材料太阴鬼石的下落
content_zh:
“蜜蜂失败了。”
某座山峰上，一个房间内。
明兰师姐黑着脸，蜜蜂，销声匿迹，不用看，死了。
“灵药峰，可真是一个危险的地方，许君白，这个人，不简单。”
“区区搬气一重天的修为，竟然能够活下来，并且杀死了蜜蜂，看来，灵药峰有着我额不知道的秘密，许君白这个人必须死，他不死，我无法安心。”
“白云派因为天元蜂大妖逃脱开始禁严，捕捉内奸，很快会查到我的头上，该死。”
明兰师姐有些着急，来回踱步。
她想要离开宗门，也做不到。
宗门封锁了，所有的任务，暂时搁置了。
内奸没找到，他们是不会善罢甘休的。
而她的处境，十分危险，一个不慎，很可能。
“撤退是不可能撤退的，只能够继续隐藏身份，许君白必须死，我的身份，不能暴露。”
“灵药峰。”
明兰师姐咬牙，她要亲自动手了。
下山不成，那么，就杀人。
杀了许君白，没人知道她的身份。
刚准备出门。
外面，传来了着急的脚步声。
隔壁的师妹被带走了，明兰师姐等了一会儿，没有人来她这里打扰。
“该死，速度这么快吗？”

“看样子是盯上我了，不行，我得赶紧离开此地，否则，性命难保。”
还杀什么人，保命要紧。
这是一个信号，她不能留在这里。
于是，想也不想，趁着没人的时候，赶紧离开洞府。
黑暗中。
几道身影藏匿着。
一个弟子着急前来汇报。
“章师兄，她有动静了，真的朝着山下跑去了。”
“果然，章师兄是对的。”
“师兄，我们要不要？”
章一刀举起手，严肃道：“按照计划进行，可不要被她跑了。”
身边的弟子立刻笑道：“放心吧，师兄，我们可是执法殿的老弟子，捉捕内奸的事情，我们可是专业的，她跑不了。”
章一刀满意点头，跟着上去。
整个白云派，都被他们的人所盯着。
任何的风吹草动，都会被他们收揽在眼里，想要逃脱，不太可能。
“该死。”
“这些狗腿子果然盯上我了，他们怎么会？”
逃跑当中的明兰师姐不断狂奔，碰到了好几次的偷袭，险而又险。
content_en:
"The bees failed."
On a certain mountain peak, in a room.
Senior Sister Minglan had a dark face and disappeared without a trace. No need to look at her, she was dead.
"Elixir Peak is really a dangerous place. Xu Junbai, this person is not simple."
"With a mere cultivation level of one level, he was able to survive and kill the bees. It seems that the Spiritual Medicine Peak has a secret that I don't know about. Xu Junbai must die. If he doesn't die, I can't feel at ease."
"The Baiyun Sect started to impose restrictions because the Tianyuan Bee Demon escaped. To capture the traitor, they will soon be found on my head, damn it."
Senior Sister Minglan was a little anxious and paced back and forth.
She wanted to leave the sect, but she couldn't.
The sect was sealed off, and all tasks were temporarily put on hold.
They won't give up until the traitor is found.
And her situation is very dangerous, and it is very possible if she is not careful.
"It is impossible to retreat. We can only continue to hide our identity. Xu Junbai must die. My identity cannot be exposed."
"Elixir Peak."
Senior sister Minglan gritted her teeth, she was going to do it herself.
If you can't get down the mountain, then kill someone.
After killing Xu Junbai, no one knew her identity.
Just getting ready to go out.
Outside, there were anxious footsteps.
The junior sister next door was taken away. Senior Sister Minglan waited for a while, but no one came to disturb her.
"Damn, is it that fast?"
"It seems that they are targeting me. No, I have to leave this place quickly, otherwise, my life will not be saved."
Who else to kill? Life is more important.
This was a sign that she couldn't stay here.
So, without thinking, he quickly left the cave while no one was around.
in the dark.
Several figures are hiding.
A disciple came anxiously to report.
"Senior Brother Zhang, she made some movement and really ran down the mountain."
"Sure enough, Senior Brother Zhang is right."
"Senior brother, do we want it?"
Zhang Yidao raised his hand and said seriously: "Proceed as planned, but don't let her run away."
The disciple next to him immediately smiled and said: "Don't worry, senior brother, we are old disciples of the Law Enforcement Hall. We are professionals in catching traitors. She can't escape."
Zhang Yidao nodded with satisfaction and followed.
The entire Baiyun Sect was being watched by their people.
Any disturbance will be caught in their eyes, and it is impossible to escape.
"Damn it."
"These bastards are indeed targeting me, how could they?"
While escaping, Senior Sister Minglan kept running wildly and encountered several sneak attacks, which were dangerous and dangerous.
